result.meaning: Read four selected original-image binding cells for two separately assayed source molecular forms and two ligands. Populate native IC50 or reported Hill-fit Kd parameters, within-form ligand ratios and their interaction/log interaction. Covariance/model source reading is unimplemented here, not a finding about the paper. No intrinsic-affinity conversion, target transfer or annotation credit.
